user.title: Connect your SwitchBot app account
user.description: Sign in to discover your frames and retrieve connection keys. No image is sent during setup. Use your app login, not the web-store account.

details.title: Choose how this frame works
details.description: Bluetooth-only image upload is supported for the 13.3-inch Frame 2. Original frames need Wi-Fi and SwitchBot cloud for new pictures. Retaining cloud sign-in is optional for Bluetooth-only use. Notification settings are optional.

data.name: Name in Home Assistant
data.keep_cloud_login: Retain SwitchBot sign-in for Wi-Fi and reconnect
data.use_example_image: Use the included I AM ASLEEP example

error.cannot_connect: Could not sign in or discover frames. Check your app login and connection. Verification-code challenges and social-only sign-in are not supported.
error.setup_failed: Check the size and connection mode. Wi-Fi/hybrid need retained login. A notification switch needs an example or own picture. Bluetooth setup also needs a valid frame key.
error.unknown: Setup could not finish. No picture was sent. Try again or report a redacted error.

abort.no_frames: No supported art frame was found in this app account.

init.title: Notification and optional AI generation
init.description: Cloudflare receives generation prompts using your account. Leave its fields empty to use uploaded photos only. Your token stays in Home Assistant.
